team_identity_notes: Delhi Daredevils and Delhi Capitals are treated as one continuing franchise.
Kings XI Punjab and Punjab Kings are treated as one continuing franchise.
The Royal Challengers Bangalore/Bengaluru naming change is treated as one continuing franchise.
Deccan Chargers and Sunrisers Hyderabad remain separate entities: SRH was a replacement franchise, not a rename.
Rising Pune Supergiant and Gujarat Lions are independent 2016-17 teams, not continuations of CSK or RR.

validation.note: Published NRR and ordering are authoritative; calculated NRR is retained for audit.
